name: What changes should I make to my listing before relisting an expired home?

mainEntity.name: What changes should I make to my listing before relisting an expired home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before relisting, a thorough review of your property and market strategy is crucial to avoid another expiration. Common changes include adjusting the asking price to better align with current market values and recent comparable sales, especially in competitive areas like Brickell or South Beach. Consider making minor repairs, decluttering, or staging enhancements to improve buyer appeal. High-quality professional photography and compelling property descriptions are also essential. Kelby Contreras can provide an expert assessment of your property's presentation and market positioning, suggesting specific improvements that resonate with buyers in your local market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Review pricing, property condition, staging, and photography. Adjustments based on market feedback and professional advice are key to a successful relist.
